visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of several finished dim sum pieces wrapped in pale green cabbage leaves, tied with a dark green vegetable strand, and topped with a mixture of minced shrimp and mushrooms. Bright studio lighting illuminates the dish on a white plate. (2) A pair of hands wearing clear plastic gloves pours chopped translucent shrimp from a small glass bowl into a larger bowl containing ground pink meat. The background is a clean, light wood surface. (3) Hands add diced dark brown mushrooms, yellow minced ginger, and chopped green onions to the bowl. More chopped white and pale green cabbage hearts are added and stirred with chopsticks. (4) Hands sprinkle white seasoning powder and pour amber-colored oil over the mixture. The hands then vigorously mix the meat and vegetables together, later adding white cornstarch to the paste-like mixture. (5) The hands pick up a broad Napa cabbage leaf, roll it into a circular ring on a wooden cutting board, and trim the bottom with scissors. A spoonful of the meat filling is pressed firmly into the cabbage ring. (6) A long green water lily stem is wrapped around the cabbage roll and tied into a knot. The completed rolls are placed onto a perforated sheet inside a round wooden steamer basket. (7) Final presentation shot of the cooked cabbage dumplings arranged on a blue and white patterned plate, appearing juicy and ready to serve.
